2026-07-30 13:58:25.503433 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:

2026-07-30 13:58:25.503440 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-30 13:58:25.503443 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-30 13:58:25.503447 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-30 13:58:25.503451 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-07-30 13:58:25.503454 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-07-30 13:58:25.503458 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
